title: Pointwise affine spectrum conjugacy for termwise representatives
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with a pullback proof for the square of their spectrum global-section maps. Fix chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], objects $K,K\prime$, and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $c$ be Coordinates for $\phi$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition] and $d$ Coordinates for its explicit spectrum transport [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates]. Assume $d.P=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.P$ and $d.N=(X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.N$ as termwise complexes. For each point $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X\prime,\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and each $i\in\mathbf Z$, the additive arrows underlying stalkComparison for $c$ at $X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}(z_0)$ and for $d$ at $z_0$ are isomorphic in the arrow category of abelian groups. Neither horizontal comparison is assumed invertible.

proof.text: Normalize each stalkComparison by postcomposing with inverse comparisonStalkHomologyIso and the stalk cohomology map of eprime. Naturality of comparisonStalkHomologyIso for the chain map t, cancellation of the invertible counit and the represents equation identify the result with comparisonIntoPullback followed by cohomology of Lgprime*(e) and phi. This is proved locally as spectrum_stalkComparison_normalized, without assuming the comparison invertible.

Apply the source-only affine spectrum transport to c.P and d.P, using hP, their K-flatness, their counit isomorphisms and c.e,d.e. It gives the source isomorphism l and a natural isomorphism T of additive derived stalk cohomology functors.

Naturality of T at phi and the cancellation equation affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso.inv ; affineSpectrumDerivedMorphism = L(Xprime.isoSpec.inv)*(phi) allow postcomposition of the source-only square by phi0. The two normalization equations then give a commuting square for stalkComparison. The target isomorphism is the original normalization isomorphism followed by T at Kprime and the inverse spectrum normalization isomorphism. Cancel the spectrum normalization isomorphism and apply Arrow.isoMk.
